def transform_rule(row):
    """Fill all gaps between 5s, end-fill 22-23 only if last_5 <= 21."""
    result = row[:]
    five_positions = [i for i, x in enumerate(row) if x == 5]
    non_marker_vals = [x for x in row if x not in [3, 5]]
    bg = max(set(non_marker_vals), key=non_marker_vals.count)
    
    # Fill all gaps between consecutive 5s
    for i in range(len(five_positions)-1):
        gap_start = five_positions[i] + 1
        gap_end = five_positions[i+1] - 1
        for j in range(gap_start, gap_end+1):
            if result[j] == bg:
                result[j] = 3
    
    # End-fill only if last_5 <= 21 and no 5 at 23
    last_5 = five_positions[-1] if five_positions else -1
    has_5_at_23 = 23 in five_positions if five_positions else False
    no_end_fill_first_5 = (last_5 <= 21) and (not has_5_at_23)
    end_fill_range = 2 if no_end_fill_first_5 else 0
    
    if no_end_fill_first_5:
        for col in [22, 23]:
            if col < len(result) and result[col] == bg:
                result[col] = 3
    
    return result
